method.value: Fit the CO(4) velocity field with circular rotation plus m=2 azimuthal and radial components; derive enclosed dynamical mass and baryon fraction.

evidence.quote: To estimate the degree of non-circular motion, we fit the observed CO(4) velocity field using a combination of circular and $m=2$ Fourier mode models(cite: 2007ApJ...664..204S).

referee_caveats_inferred: Near-face-on geometry makes absolute velocities, dynamical mass and inflow sensitive to a physically constrained inclination prior.
Reducing sampled gas masses to satisfy the dynamical mass budget can reshape the inflow uncertainty distribution.
Scaling F444W and [CI] intensity directly to mass leaves spatial variations in stellar mass-to-light ratio and gas excitation untested.
The CO-based pattern-speed measurement lacks an independent stellar-tracer check.
The molecular-gas section gives CO(1) luminosity units as L⊙, whereas the summary table gives K km s−1 pc²; use the table cautiously as an answer key.
The fully specified 2D fitting implementation and posterior diagnostics are absent.
